LESSON: HUMAN RIGHTS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Governance
Topic 5.2: Human Rights
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Human Rights, part of Governance in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to respect human rights?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Human Rights together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: Learners undertake tasks that will enable them to come up with new ideas they identify the basic human rights in

Kenya using appropriate media and share in class.

• Learning to learn: Learners develop motivation to learn as they engage with a resource person on the importance of human rights and write a

report.

Values:
• Unity: Learners respect other people’s opinion as they discuss in groups the importance of human rights in society and do class presentations.

• Respect: Learners value human dignity as they recite poems and sing songs on importance of human rights in society.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Human Rights and Responsibilities: Learners enhance understanding of children’s rights as they recite poems and sing songs on importance of

human rights in society.

• Social Cohesion: Learners care for one another as they develop posters to create awareness on the importance of respecting human rights in

society.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: Why is it important to respect human rights?
